pete: RFC follow-up: thinking of splitting eviction into Allocator (rank + token issue) and Owner (local apply + safety). posting prototype plan and want failure-mode checks.

sana: ok. main worry: owner ACKs then crashes before apply -> allocator thinks applied.

lee: owner should persist pending-token journal before ACK. flow: alloc -> token -> owner persists pending(token) -> ACK -> apply CAS(prefix_epoch) -> clear pending. reconciler inspects pending entries after restart.

pete: token shape: prefix, lease_epoch, token_id, expires_at, sig. owner validates sig and lease_epoch. idempotency keyed by token_id.

nadia: ops: do soft-demote first (priority drop) so we can exercise paths without immediate evictions. reconciler must rate-limit and jitter to avoid herd.

sana: tests: crash-between-ack-and-apply, reissue-without-epoch-bump, corrupted-sig. metrics: owner_pending_count, reconcile_fix_rate, prefix_misread_rate. add alert if prefix_misread_rate > 0 for 5m.

pete: timeline: I'll prototype owner journal + CAS this sprint and open a draft PR. pairing with @lee on correctness doc.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary schedule set: evict-split-canary v0.1 -> nodeset tiny-canary at sha:beefcafe.

sana: :thumbsup:
